friends.name: Pip
friends.clue: A little reflected light pauses beside a sheltered mark.
friends.observation: Pip tips his lantern, then pauses to look again.
friends.approachHint: Wait quietly so Pip has time to look.

friends.name: Tansy
friends.clue: A careful friend is making room around rescued seedlings.
friends.observation: Tansy is holding a loose stem away from a new shoot.
friends.approachHint: Offer to help with one small garden job.

friends.name: Nib
friends.clue: A small builder has made a wobbly practice puzzle beside camp.
friends.observation: Nib rolls a round twig toward a little brace and grins.
friends.approachHint: Invite Nib to try the playful practice puzzle together.

friends.name: Flutter
friends.clue: Three tiny shakes in a leaf repeat beside the hollow.
friends.observation: Flutter is watching a leaf tremble and waiting for the next little signal.
friends.approachHint: Wait and listen, or watch the visible leaf marks, beside Flutter.

friends.name: Cleo
friends.clue: Two different shelf pieces wait beside a little workbench.
friends.observation: Cleo is trying to hold a shelf and choose its next piece at the same time.
friends.approachHint: Offer to hold one piece while Cleo tries the other.

friends.name: Bramble
friends.clue: A steady friend checks both handles before lifting a crate.
friends.observation: Bramble is looking at a crate with two handles.
friends.approachHint: Offer to take one handle before Bramble lifts.

friends.name: Patter
friends.clue: A cheerful courier has put a rest mark on the delivery map.
friends.observation: Patter sets down a parcel beside a marked rest bench.
friends.approachHint: Wait for Patter’s rest instead of asking for a race.

friends.name: Twizzle
friends.clue: A bright little flag moves with an unfinished tune.
friends.observation: Twizzle tries a tiny tune, then waves its matching flag.
friends.approachHint: Play one short call-and-answer signal with Twizzle.

friends.name: Luna
friends.clue: A gentle lamp marks one small turn at the edge of dusk.
friends.observation: Luna looks at the first marked turn and takes a slow breath.
friends.approachHint: Wait beside Luna until she is ready for one small step.

friends.name: Pebble
friends.clue: Someone has drawn a fresh line beside an old tide mark.
friends.observation: Pebble compares the old mark with today’s water.
friends.approachHint: Offer to help check the mark before using it.

friends.name: Sail
friends.clue: A guide flag is folded beside someone who usually waves goodbye.
friends.observation: Sail turns the folded flag into a little route-finding game.
friends.approachHint: Invite Sail to join the guide game rather than watch from shore.

friends.name: Glimmer
friends.clue: Soft glowing marks lead between quiet rescued creatures.
friends.observation: Glimmer checks a shelter and leaves room for a resting visitor.
friends.approachHint: Offer gentle help marking the path between shelters.
